answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade. One stake buys one identity, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes, while honest agents recover theirs in full. Misbehavior proved by peers slashes the stake, and slashed funds reward the reporters, so a Sybil swarm pays for its own detection. A haven admits only bonded members; a willow stands firm when every whisper of a new account must carry real collateral.
